title: Crying Broken Doll
description: A broken porcelain doll with a cracked head and detached limbs lies sprawled on a ritualistic floor, screaming with an open mouth. The dark hallway walls are covered in chalk drawings of demons, spiders, candles, and occult symbols.
prompt: A horrifying broken porcelain baby doll with a cracked bald head and screaming open mouth, limbs detached and reattached with golden rings, lying sprawled on a dark floor covered in white chalk occult symbols, beetles, and circles. Behind it a wall covered in demonic chalk drawings including a horned devil figure, candles and spiders. Dark surreal nightmare scene, high contrast black and white with gold accents, creepy atmosphere.
